problem: Find the equation of the left-opening parabola that has its vertex at $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(-1,-4).$
worked_solution:
The general standard equation of a parabola whose vertex is $(0,0)$ and whose arms open right or left is given by

$$
{y}^{2}=4px.
$$

Since we know the given parabola passes through the point $(-1,-4),$ we can substitute $x=-1$ and $y=-4$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ (-4)^{2} & =4p(-1) \\ 16 & =-4p \\ p & =-4\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {y}^{2} & =4(-4)x \\ {y}^{2} & =-16x.\end{aligned}
$$
